description: Without part_id: lists the attachments of a message with their type, size, whether the policy allows fetching them and whether their text can be read. With part_id: returns that one attachment. Small text and images come back inline so you can read them; a PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint or OpenDocument file can be read as text with mode="text", which is the only way to read a document without access to this server's filesystem; anything else is written to the download directory, if one is configured, and you get the path. part_id must come from a listing call of this same tool. Executables are refused even when they claim to be something else — including when writing to disk.

mailbox.description: Mailbox (folder) name exactly as returned by list_mailboxes, e.g. "INBOX" or "INBOX/Archive". Defaults to the configured mailbox.

max_chars.description: Characters of extracted text to return, default 20000. Only with mode "text".

mode.description: "auto" (default) reads small text and images inline, saves to disk where a download directory is configured, and otherwise extracts the text of a PDF or Office document; "inline" always returns the content; "file" always saves it; "text" extracts the text of a PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint or OpenDocument file.

offset.description: Character offset into the extracted text, for reading on from a previous call. Only with mode "text".

part_id.description: MIME part id from a previous listing call. Omit to list the attachments.

uid.description: IMAP UID of the message, as returned by the listing tools.

name: get_attachments

extractable.description: True when get_attachments with mode "text" can read this part as text.

body.description: Only for a text attachment or extracted text.

anyOf.description: What the bytes actually are, whatever was declared.

encoding.description: How the content came back on "returned". "extracted_text" means this server read the text out of a binary document.

next_offset.description: Pass back as offset to read on. Null at the end of the document.

total_chars.description: Characters of extracted text in the whole document.

title: List, read or download attachments
